verses.text: Ha winhaj Ben-adad sreyal Siria, ix smolb'ej masanil heb' soldado winh. Ay pax 32 heb' winh rey junnhej ix yutej sb'a yet' winh yet' pax schej heb' winh yet' skarruaje heb' winh yik owal. Ix jawi heb' winh yak' owal t'a chonhab' Samaria, ix och hoyan heb' winh t'a spatik jun chonhab' chi'.
Ix yak'ankot schekab' heb' winh t'a winhaj Acab sreyal Israel, ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: Ha winhaj Ben-adad ix onh chekankot ul kala':
Wik yaj masanil a b'eyumal, heb' ix etb'eyum te wach' yet' heb' uninal te wach', xchikot winh, xchi heb' chekab' chi'.
Ix yalanb'at winhaj Acab chi' t'a winh icha tik: Mamin rey, ujokab' icha ix al chi'. Ha in tik yet' masanil tastak ay t'ayin ikokab'i, xchib'at winh.

Ix jaxpax heb' chekab' chi' t'a winhaj Acab chi', ix yalanxi heb' icha tik: Icha tik ix yutej winhaj Ben-adad yalanxikoti: Toxo ix walb'at t'ayach to wik yaj masanil a b'eyumal, heb' ix etb'eyum yet' pax heb' uninal.

Hanhejtona' yab' icha tik k'ik'an, swak'anb'at heb' yajalil heb' in soldado yik sb'at yilan heb' masanil tas ay t'a yol a palakio yet' yoltak spat heb' winh ayoch yajalil het'ok. Masanil tas ol snib'ej heb', ol yik'kot heb', xchi winh, xchi heb' chekab' chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yawtankot masanil heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' winhaj Acab chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb': --¿Tas tz'aj he naan a ex tik? Ha winhaj Ben-adad chi' wannhej sayan winh tas ol yutej onh yixtani, wach'chom a in tik toxo ix wal t'a winh to syal wak'an in b'eyumal, heb' ix wetb'eyum yet' heb' wuninal t'a winh, xchi winh.
Ix yalan heb' ichamtak winak chi' yet' masanil heb' chonhab': --Mamin rey, manh a cha ab' tas syalkot winh chi' t'ayach, xchi heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj rey Acab chi' t'a heb' schekab' winhaj Ben-adad chi': --Alek t'a winh rey wajal chi', ol in k'anab'ajej masanil tas ix yal winh t'a sb'ab'elal, palta haxo tas syalkot winh t'ayin tiknaik, manhxo ol in k'anab'ajejlaj, xchib'at winh. Icha chi' ix aj yalanxik'och heb' schekab' winhaj Ben-adad chi'.

Ix schekanxikot heb' schekab' winh chi' junelxo t'a winhaj rey Acab chi', ix yalankot winh: Aokab' juntzanh Dios tz'ak'anoch in yaelal tato max in satel Samaria chi' t'a junelnhej. Manh ol yab'laj sk'alemal yik syik'ankot jun jopok yik junjun heb' in soldado, xchi winh.
Ix yalanxib'at winhaj Acab chi' t'a winhaj Ben-adad chi' icha tik: Manh smojok syik'chaanh sb'a junok mach to wanto sb'at t'a owal, icha junok mach to wanxo sjaxi, xchib'at winh.

Wan yuk'an anh winhaj Ben-adad chi' yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh rey ayek' yet' winh t'a skampamento ayik ix yab'an winh tas ix yal heb' chekab' chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a heb' yajalil heb' soldado to syak' lista sb'a heb' yik syak'an owal yet' jun chonhab' chi'. Yuj chi' ix yak'an lista sb'a heb'.

Yakb'an chi', ix jawi jun winh schekab' Dios t'a winhaj Acab chi', ix yalan winh: --Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Scham wal ilan jantak heb' ajk'ol chi', palta ol wak'och heb' t'a yol a k'ab' t'a jun k'u tik, yik wach' ol ojtakejeli to a inton Jehová Dios in, xchi Jehová, xchi winh chekab' chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Acab chi', ¿mach yuj ol ak'jokoch heb' t'a yol in k'ab' chi'? xchi winh. --Ha Jehová ix halani to a yuj heb' winh kelemtak skolwaj yet' heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yoltak a makb'en tik, a yuj heb' winh ol ak' ganar, xchi winh schekab' Dios chi'. --¿Palta mach ol b'ab'laj yamanoch owal chi'? xchi winhaj Acab chi'. --Ha extoni, xchi winh chekab' chi'.
Yuj chi' ix smolb'ej 232 heb' winh kelemtak chi' winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix smolb'anpax heb' soldado winh ayek' ta', uke' mil heb' t'a smasanil.

Chimk'ualil wal ix el heb', b'ab'el sb'at heb' winh kelemtak chi' yuj heb', haxo winhaj Ben-adad yet' 32 heb' winh rey ajun yet'ok, hanheja' yuk'an anh heb' winh t'a yol skampamento. Ayik ix alji t'a winh yuj heb' soldado ayel yila' to ay juntzanh winak ix el t'a yol chonhab' Samaria,
ix yalan winh icha tik: Wach'chom t'a junk'olal ix elul heb', ma owal jun, yamek heb', pitzan heb' tzeyik'ankot heb' t'ayin t'a tik, xchi winh.
Ha heb' winh kelemtak skolwaj t'a heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun chonhab' yik Israel chi', b'ab'el heb' winh, tzak'anoch masanil heb' soldado yuj heb' winh.

Junjun heb' ix milancham junjun heb' sirio ajk'ol chi'. Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' sirio chi' elelal, haxo heb' israel ix b'at t'a spatik heb'. Haxo winhaj Ben-adad chi', ix k'e winh t'a yib'anh schej yet' juntzanhxo heb' soldado, ix b'atkan heb' elelal.
Ix ak'ji ganar heb' sirio chi' yuj heb' israel chi', ix yik'ankan nok' chej heb' yet' karruaje yik owal. Te niwan heb' sirio chi' ix chami.

Ixlajwi chi' ix jax winh schekab' Dios chi' t'a winhaj Acab sreyal Israel chi', ix yalan winh: --Ha tiknaik scham wal a naani tas tzutej ak'anoch stz'akub' heb' winh a soldado tik, yujto ha t'a junxo ab'il yab' icha tik, sjax heb' sirio tik yak' owal et' junelxo, xchi winh.

Hanheja' ix yalanpax heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado sirio chi' t'a winh sreyal chi' icha tik: --Ha juntzanh sdiosal heb' israel chi', sdiosal jolomtak witz. Yuj chi', ix onh yak' ganar heb'. Palta tato ha t'a panhkiltak skak' owal yet' heb', skak' ganar heb'.
Mamin rey, a tas tza k'ulej tiknaik to maxtzak ak'och heb' winh rey tik yajalilok heb' soldado, say sk'exul heb' winh.

Tzak'anpaxoch heb' soldado icha sb'isul heb' ix ak'ji ganar chi', lajan tz'aj sb'isul heb' yet' nok' chej yet' pax karruaje. Slajwi chi' tzonh b'at kak' owal yet' heb' israel t'a lum panhkiltak chi', ol kilan b'ian tato manh ol kak' ganar heb', xchi heb'. Ix schaan yab' winhaj Ben-adad tas ix yal heb' chi'.
Ayik ix ek' jun ab'il chi', ix yak'an lista heb' soldado winhaj Ben-adad chi', ix jawi heb' t'a chonhab' Afec yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' israel chi'.

Hanhejtona' ix yak'anpax lista sb'a heb' winh soldado israel chi', ix ak'ji syamk'ab' heb' yik sb'at heb' yak' owal yet' heb' sirio chi'. Ix b'at heb' israel chi', ix sb'oank'e skampamento heb' t'a yichanh heb' sirio chi'. Lajan wal yilji heb' icha chab'ok makte'al nok' chiwa, haxo pax heb' soldado yik heb' sirio chi' jun, majnakel sat lum ak'lik chi' yuj heb'.

Ha wal ta' ix jawi jun winh schekab' Dios t'a winhaj Acab sreyal Israel chi', ix yalan winh icha tik t'a winh: --Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Yujto a heb' sirio tik ix halani to a in tik sDiosal in lum jolomtak witz, manh in sDiosalok lum panhkiltak, yuj chi' a tiknaik ol wak'och juntzanh tzijtumal anima tik t'a yol a k'ab', icha wal chi' ol aj ojtakaneli to a in ton Jehová Dios in, xchi Jehová, xchi winh chekab' chi'.

Uke' k'ual tonhej ix ajek' heb' soldado sirio t'a yichanh heb' soldado israel chi', ix lajwi chi' ix syamanoch heb' yak'an owal. Ha t'a jun k'u chi' 100 mil soldado yik heb' sirio chi' sb'ey t'a yok ix cham yuj heb' israel chi'.

Haxo juntzanhxo heb' soldado chi', ix b'at heb' elelal t'a chonhab' Afec. Haxo smuroal jun chonhab' chi' ix kot lanhnaj t'a yib'anh heb', 27 mil heb' soldado ix el chi' ix chami. Ix pax lemnaj winhaj Ben-adad chi', ix k'och winh t'a jun chonhab' chi', tzuli tzek' winh sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a yoltak pat.

Yuj chi' haxo heb' ayoch yajalil yet' winh ix halan t'ay icha tik: --Ix kab'i to a heb' winh sreyal Israel ay yok'elk'olal heb' winh, yuj chi' komonok scha a k'ool skak'och pichul ya swa'i, skak'anoch lasu t'a ko jaj. Slajwi chi' b'at ko ch'oxan ko b'a t'a winh sreyal Israel chi', talaj tz'ok' sk'ol winh t'ayonh, manh ol onh smilchamlaj winh, xchi heb' t'a winhaj Ben-adad chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yak'anoch pichul heb' ya swa'i, ix yak'anoch lasu heb' t'a sjaj, ix b'at heb' sch'ox sb'a t'a winh sreyal Israel chi', ix yalan heb': --Mamin rey, a winh a chekab' aj Ben-adad, tzonh schekkot winh kal t'ayach, komonok tz'ok' a k'ool max a milchamlaj winh, xchi heb'. Ix tak'wi winhaj Acab chi' t'a heb' icha tik: --¿Tom pitzanto winh jun? Ha t'a in sat, icha wuk'tak yaj winh, xchi winh.

Te wach' ix yal winh rey chi' ix yab' heb', yuj chi' ix yal heb' icha tik: --Mamin rey, a winh uk'tak aj Ben-adad chi' pitzanto winh, xchi heb'. --B'at ik'ekkot winh an, xchi winhaj Acab chi' t'a heb'. Yuj chi' ix jawi winhaj Ben-adad chi' t'a yichanh winh, ix yak'ank'e winh winh t'a yol skarruaje.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Ben-adad chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik a juntzanh chonhab' yik'nak ek' winh in mam t'a winh a mam, swak'xikan t'ayach. Syal sb'at heb' a chonhwajum t'a Damasco icha sk'ulejnak heb' schonhwajum winh in mam chi' t'a Samaria, xchi winh. --Tato icha chi', ol ach wak'el t'a libre, xchi winhaj Acab chi'. Icha chi' ix aj sb'oan jun strato heb' chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix pax winhaj Ben-adad chi'.

Palta ay jun winh t'a skal heb' winh schekab' Jehová, a Jehová ix halan t'a winh, yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a jun winh yetb'eyum icha tik: --Ak' in echnaj in k'ana', xchi winh. Palta maj yal-laj sk'ool winh yetb'eyum winh chi'.

Ix yalan winh schekab' Dios chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Yujto maj a k'anab'ajej tas ix yal Jehová, yuj chi' ayik ol ach el t'a in tz'ey tik, ay jun nok' choj ol ach milanchamok, xchi winh. Ayik ix el winh chi' t'a stz'ey winh schekab' Dios chi', haxo t'a yol b'e ix elta jun nok' choj t'a winh, ix miljicham winh yuj nok'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schalan sb'a winh schekab' Dios chi' yet' junxo winh winak, ix yalanxi winh t'a winh icha tik: Ak' in echnajok, xchi winh. Ha jun winh chi' ix mak'an winh schekab' Dios chi', ix lajwi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winh schekab' Dios chi' smaklej winh rey t'a yol b'e. Ix sk'exanel sb'a winh, ix smusan sat winh t'a jun k'apak.

Ayik wan yek'b'at winh rey chi' ta', te chaanh ix yal winh schekab' Dios chi': --Mamin rey, a in a chekab' in tik, ix in b'at t'a owal. Ha t'a skal heb' soldado ix elta jun winh soldado ix yik'ankot jun winh ajk'ol winh t'ayin. Ix yalan winh t'ayin to tzin tanhwej jun winh chi'. Ix cham wal yalan winh tato swaktejel winh ajk'ol chi', a inxo tzin cham sk'exulok winh, mato yowalil swak' oxeok arroba k'een plata.

Palta mamin rey, a in tik yakb'an ay jab'ok tas wan in k'ulani, ix el lemnaj winh ajk'ol chi' t'ayin, xchi winh t'a winhaj Acab chi'. Ix tak'wi winhaj Acab sreyal Israel chi': --Munil a ach ix alk'eta a mul yet' tas ol elul t'a ib'anh yuj, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anel smusil sat winh schekab' Dios chi'. Haxo ix yilan winh rey chi' to a jun winh chi' a junok heb' winh schekab' Dios.

Ix yalan winh schekab' Dios chi': --Icha wal tik yalan Jehová: Ha ach tik ix aktejb'at jun winh winak ix wala' to yowalil schami, yuj chi' a ach ol ach cham sk'exulok winh, haxo a chonhab' ol satel sk'exulok yik winh, xchi Jehová, xchi winh schekab' Dios chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atkan winhaj Acab chi' t'a Samaria, ix chab'axk'e sk'ool winh. Wan schichon sk'ool winh ix ochkan winh t'a yol spalakio.
